comment_box: Abortion is healthcare. Decisions about one's healthcare belong between the patient and their healthcare provider ONLY. It's that simple. Female veterans have laid their lives on the line to protect this country. Why should they have to lay their lives on the line just to be pregnant? Restriction on abortion access puts these women's lives at risk. There are many maternal complications and fetal anomalies for which abortion should be part of the menu of options provided to a pregnant woman. Aside from that, if someone doesn't want to be pregnant, they shouldn't have to be. Restricting healthcare in this fashion is dangerous, disrespectful, and harmful to our female veterans.
